MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Heat shrink tubing fits the wiring work suggested by my battery holder, relay, switches, and jumper wires because it helps insulate and organize connections.",
    "The alligator clips could make checking breadboard circuits and relay wiring easier by holding test connections in place, provided they fit my leads."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The carboy handle, magnetic base, and mill readout require specific equipment that my purchases do not show I own or use.",
    "My infrared thermometer makes temperature-related suggestions understandable, but measuring a surface temperature does not mean I need to control a heating or cooling setup.",
    "The degreaser, silica packets, gloves, and brad nails offer possible practical uses, but none addresses a specific task I currently have evidence of needing to do."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions seem to treat an interest in practical tools and hardware as a reason to recommend supplies for many unrelated projects.",
    "Owning a measuring tool seems to have been stretched into an interest in specialized temperature-control and machining equipment."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Several of my purchases work together around small electronic circuits, so accessories that help connect, test, and insulate those circuits have a clearer purpose for me.",
    "I need a concrete use and compatible equipment before choosing an accessory; a broadly useful workshop item alone is not enough.",
    "My latest caster purchase suggests a furniture-mobility task, but it does not establish that I have a nailer, mill, lathe, or brewing setup."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my hands-on projects but often missed the specific wiring tasks and equipment compatibility that make an item useful to me."
}
